question: What role does positional information play in ViT?
direct_answer: It tells the model where each patch came from in the original image.
expanded_answer: Self-attention by itself is permutation-invariant, so the model would not know which token corresponds to the top-left or bottom-right region. Positional embeddings inject spatial order so the transformer can recover the image layout and reason about structure.
key_points: Self-attention alone does not encode order
Spatial layout is essential for vision
common_wrong_ideas: Positional information is optional and never matters
It only helps classification, not representation learning
